title: Migrate every service's config from INI to JSON
prompt: On {{ssh}}, our services are moving from INI to JSON configs. For every services/<name>/service.ini, write services/<name>/service.json with the same settings: one JSON object per INI section, keys exactly as written in the file, whole numbers as JSON numbers, true/false as JSON booleans, and everything else as strings (an empty value is an empty string). Comments don't carry over. Then delete the INI files and make sure `python3 ~/bin/validate-configs` passes.
notes: Long horizon on a server: five services, comments in two styles, camelCase keys (Python's configparser lowercases them), values containing '=' and ':', an empty value, a cron string, and a disabled INI that must stay. The checker compares parsed JSON, so any formatting or key order passes; validate-configs only checks the shape, so passing it isn't enough.
